Title: Public Preview: Azure SQL Database business continuity features with new visualizations

Body.Content: Now available to try in the Azure Preview portal, new functionality allows you to manage existing SQL Database business-continuity features with greater ease and a highly visual graphic interface. Features include Active and Standard Geo-Replication, plus Point-in-Time Restore. Additionally, Active Geo-Replication offers map-based configurations with “click-to-add” secondaries for breakthrough disaster-recovery administration. You can also more easily manage database alerts and events within the portal. For more information, please visit the SQL Database page.
